supported_conclusion: A transient-category HttpRequestException occurred before a complete response was durably captured. The journal does not identify DNS, connection, protocol, response truncation, provider state, or exact send/body-read boundary. This is not recorded as a timeout. Status is assigned only after the entire body is read, so null status does not prove headers never arrived.
bounded_new_hypothesis: A fresh independent session on the same frozen source and profile can test whether selection now yields a complete retained response and then exercise the previously untested populated-scope correction. This is a new diagnostic, never replay or continuation of the abandoned request/run.
interpretation_limit: A successful new selection would establish present progress, not prove the historical cause or exclude old-payload-specific incompatibility; the new intent may produce a different selection payload. No evidence supports modifying timeout, schema, reasoning, or accounting settings.

reservation_explanation.formula: max(project phase input threshold, UTF8 bytes of the complete dispatched LLMRequest); project input threshold is a reservation floor, not an advisory-mode rejection ceiling.
reservation_explanation.future_explanation: Unknown future input is bounded conservatively by declared context allowance after output allocation; each actual dispatch instead prices its known complete serialized input.
